text:
Maya: Quick shoutout to Alex, Priya, and the oncall duo — y'all pulled the canary back into shape in record time. Left a small treat (sprinkle donuts) in the kitchen as a thank you :confetti_ball:
Alex: Thanks! Priya found the race condition in the routing policy. Team effort.
Priya: Didn't even need extra coffee, but accepted anyway :coffee: Also big props to Jordan for the rollback script.
Jordan: ty! Happy to help — rollback was literally 2 lines: `kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deploy/edge`
Taylor: Those donuts did not survive the 3pm meeting 😂 morale boost confirmed.
Sam: Virtual high five from product — appreciate the quick heads-up in #release-war-room.
Maya: Tiny logistics note: left a sticky on the box saying "for ops & docs" so folks don't accidentally take all of them.
kudos-bot: Maya gave a shoutout to Alex, Priya, Jordan — 3 kudos awarded :sparkles:
Priya: Aww thanks @Maya and @kudos-bot :smile:
Alex: Coffee next week is on me. Who's in? :raised_hands:
Sam: Count me in. Also can we get a tiny "sprinkles" emoji in our set? Asking for science.
